cancellation_summary: Full refund with appropriate notice based on group size; no refund for late arrivals
meeting_point: Ilima Court Shopping Center, 75-5629 Kuakini Highway, Kailua Kona, HI 96740
description: Join us aboard the Kona Explorer, our 41 ft. Super-Raft, for a 2.5-hour sunset tour along the Kona coast. Relax and enjoy front-row seats to Hawaii’s stunning coastal sunset with Hawaiian-inspired cuisine and the option to purchase alcoholic beverages. With plenty of seating and a focus on comfort, this is the perfect way to unwind and experience the beauty of the golden hour from the water.
what_is_included:
- Hawaiian-inspired cuisine
- Front-row seats to the sunset
itinerary:
- Departure from Kailua Pier
- Coastal cruise with no set destination, enjoying the scenic views
- Return to Kailua Pier after watching the sunset
highlights:
- Luxurious 41 ft. Super-Raft with comfortable seating
- Beautiful coastal sunset
- Hawaiian-inspired cuisine
- Commentary on local landmarks and marine life
check_in_details: Arrive 30 minutes prior to departure; free parking is available at the Ilima Court Shopping Center.
special_requirements: - For gluten-free, vegetarian, or vegan meals, call 800.551.8911 at least 48 hours before your adventure.
restrictions:
- Not suitable for pregnant women
- Physical agility required for boarding
- No smoking on the vessel
faqs:
- **Can children join the tour?** Children under 5 are not permitted on this tour.
- **Is food included?** Yes, Hawaiian-inspired cuisine is included; alcoholic beverages are available for purchase.
- **Is there commentary during the tour?** Yes, the crew provides commentary on local landmarks and marine life.
